_read_me: A tour of the invented application in demo/. Every step points at an automation id, and every step says how it will know it is finished — read back out of the application, never assumed from having sent a click.
title: Putting an order on the system
about: Six steps, from an empty screen to a saved order. Do them yourself, or press Do it for me and watch.

steps.say: Start with a clean order. This clears anything left on the screen.
Type who the order is for. Any name will do — everything here is invented.
steps.whyNot: This one is typing, and typing is the step a tour should not do for you: you would not remember it.

steps.say: Find a part. This fills the part number in for you.
Add the line to the order. Nothing is saved yet.
Look at Save the order. It was greyed out a moment ago; now there is a line, it is not.
steps.whyNot: There is nothing to do here. The step is finished the moment the application allows it, which is the point being made.

steps.say: Save the order. It gets a reference, and printing labels becomes possible.
